llm.summary: The skill's requests and instructions are coherent with its stated purpose (a paid token-scanning API using an HTTP payment handshake); it does not ask for unrelated credentials or install code, but it does require the user to sign on-chain payments using their wallet outside the skill.

dimensions.detail: The name/description match the behavior in SKILL.md: it describes calling a Quick Intel scan endpoint that requires an on-chain x402 payment. No extraneous credentials, binaries, or unrelated accesses are requested.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions are scoped to preparing a scan request, handling a 402 payment challenge, building/signing the payment (EVM or Solana flows), retrying the request, and returning results. The SKILL.md does not instruct reading unrelated files or environment variables. It does assume an external wallet will sign payments; the skill does not instruct exfiltration of private keys.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: This is an instruction-only skill with no install spec or code to write to disk. That is the lowest-risk install posture and matches the skill's described usage.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill declares no required environment variables or secrets. The only sensitive operation implied is signing a payment with a wallet/private key — which the SKILL.md expects to be performed by the user's wallet (not by providing keys to the skill). If a user were to provide private keys or wallet secrets to an agent to automate signing, that would be high risk, but the skill itself doesn't request them.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Flags are default (not always:true). The skill does not request persistent system modifications or special privileges, nor does it modify other skill configs.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill is internally consistent: it calls an external scan API that charges $0.03 via an on-chain payment handshake. Before using it, verify the endpoint domain (x402.quickintel.io), be prepared to sign a small USDC payment with a secure wallet (do not paste private keys into the agent), check that the gateway returns a valid on-chain receipt before trusting results, and confirm the token address and chain names are correct. If you want automation that signs transactions, prefer using a hardware or well-audited wallet connector rather than giving raw keys to the agent.
